rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for litter and discarded refuse.

example.english: Don't throw this debris into the street.
example.traditional: 呢啲垃圾唔好掉落街呀。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 laap6 saap3 m4 hou2 diu6 lok6 gaai1 aa3

rows.note: Use this for rubble left by a collapsed or destroyed building or area.

example.english: After the building collapsed, the site was left with debris everywhere.
example.traditional: 棟大廈塌咗之後，現場淨係剩返一地瓦礫。
example.jyutping: dung6 daai6 haa6 taap3 zo2 zi1 hau6 jin6 coeng4 zing6 hai6 sing6 faan1 jat1 dei6 ngaa5 lik1

rows.note: Use this for the wreckage or remaining parts of a destroyed vehicle, structure, or object.

example.english: Rescuers found the debris of the sunken ship.
example.traditional: 救援人員喺海邊發現沉船嘅殘骸。
example.jyutping: gau3 wun4 jan4 jyun4 hai2 hoi2 bin1 faat3 jin6 cam4 syun4 ge3 caan4 haai4
